reviewedEvents.title: Japan travel advisory issued May 15, 2025
reviewedEvents.summary: The advisory issued May 15, 2025 placed Japan at Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions. It advised United States citizens to exercise caution when traveling abroad.
reviewedEvents.supports: The complete advisory feed entry supplies the publication date, country, advisory level and precaution wording. This record describes that dated issuance; it does not establish a new announcement or a live advisory level.

reviewedEvents.title: Consultation opens before the 2027 North American trade review
reviewedEvents.summary: The Office of the United States Trade Representative announced consultation on operation of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement before its 2027 annual joint review. Written comments and hearing requests are due January 12, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. The hearing date and location will be announced separately.
reviewedEvents.sourceTitle: Federal Register notice 2026-20341: North American trade agreement consultation
reviewedEvents.publisher: Office of the United States Trade Representative / Government Publishing Office
reviewedEvents.supports: Complete official document reviewed. The Federal Register header establishes publication on October 5, 2026; the October 2 filing timestamp is separate. The notice establishes a consultation and comment deadline, not a treaty amendment or new trade restriction. Canada and Mexico are relevance associations, not physical event locations. No later hearing notice was reviewed.

reviewedEvents.title: Final methionine antidumping review results for France, Japan and Spain
reviewedEvents.summary: The Department of Commerce published final results of its first five-year reviews of existing methionine antidumping duty orders for France, Japan and Spain. It found that revoking the orders would likely lead to continued or recurring dumping. The notice states that the results apply from October 5, 2026.
reviewedEvents.sourceTitle: Federal Register notice 2026-20384: Methionine antidumping review results
reviewedEvents.publisher: Department of Commerce / Government Publishing Office
reviewedEvents.supports: The complete notice establishes publication and applicability on October 5, 2026 and final results concerning existing orders. Signature and filing dates are separate. The listed margins describe the dumping likely if orders were revoked, not new tariff or cash-deposit rates. Full product scope is referred to a memorandum not reviewed here. Conflicting June initiation-date references are omitted. France, Japan and Spain are explicit relevance associations, not event locations.
